clipsets.fresh: Held-out, fresh: videos none of our tuning used
clipsets.heldout: Held-out, all: the fresh clips plus an earlier held-out check
clipsets.dev: Development: the clips we tune beside
clipsets.vc1k: VC-1K (phone video calls): phone recordings from Meta's VC-1K dataset, none of our tuning used, stratified by motion, lighting and environment

vc1k.name: VC-1K (phone video calls)
vc1k.about: (Meta, CC BY-NC 4.0), drawn by a fixed stratified rule and used by none of our tuning; we publish its numbers and clip names only, never its frames or streams.
vc1k.sample_rule: the VC-1K set (one clip per motion × lighting cell, the environment alternating, each the first of its stratum in the selection’s fixed order)
vc1k.note: numbers only: no frames, thumbnails or streams of these clips are published (most show participants' faces)

platforms.jetson: Jetson Orin Nano, Cortex-A78AE core 3 at 1.728 GHz, one thread
platforms.x86: AMD EPYC 9R45 (SIMD: avx2, avx512f, avx512ifma, avx512bw, avx512vl, avx512_bf16, avx512vbmi, avx512_vbmi2, avx512_vnni; nanocodec dispatches to its avx512 tier), one thread pinned to one physical core (AWS c8a.large, one pair at a time)
platforms.zen3: AMD EPYC 7R13 Processor (SIMD: avx2; nanocodec dispatches to its avx2 tier), one thread pinned to vCPU 1, the SMT sibling of vCPU 0 (left to the system) (AWS c6a.large, Zen 3, one pair at a time)
platforms.graviton: Neoverse-V2 (SIMD: asimd, asimddp, sve, sve2, svei8mm, i8mm, bf16; nanocodec dispatches to its neon tier), one thread pinned to one physical core (AWS c8g.large, Graviton4, one pair at a time)
